k01.title: Lumière Oval Solitaire Pendant
k01.descriptionHtml:
One oval, turned on its side. A single oval cut clear cubic zirconia, about 11mm by 9mm, is set east to west in four slim gold claws, so it sits wider than it is tall. A small jump ring hangs it from a smooth, rounded bail on a twisted rope chain about 2mm thick. Part of the Lumière line of oval cut pieces.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Studs, or with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Ring.

Details

  • Pendant: Approximately 17mm long, from the top of the bail
  • Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 11mm by 9mm, set east to west
  • Setting: Four slim gold claws
  • Bail: Smooth and polished
  • Chain: Twisted rope chain, approximately 2mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

k02.title: Marquise Solitaire Studs
k02.descriptionHtml:
One long marquise, point to point. Each stud is a single marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, about 13mm long and 7mm wide, held upright in four slim gold claws that leave both points bare. Long enough to catch the eye, light enough for every day.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with your hair tucked back, or beside a small hoop in a second piercing.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 13mm by 7mm
  • Stone: Marquise cut clear cubic zirconia
  • Setting: Four slim gold claws, the points left bare
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

k03.title: Petite Pear Solitaire Studs
k03.descriptionHtml:
A small pear, point up. Each stud is one pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 8mm by 6mm, held point up in three fine gold claws: one at the tip and two around the curve. Small and clean, made for every day.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace, or with the Petite Pear Solitaire Ring.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 8mm by 6mm
  • Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, worn point up
  • Setting: Three fine gold claws
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

k04.title: Pear Baguette Duet Studs
k04.descriptionHtml:
A pear and a baguette, side by side. Each stud pairs one pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 10mm by 6.5mm, with a slim baguette of about 9mm by 4.5mm, each in its own fine gold claws. The pear sits a little higher than the baguette, and the two studs are mirror images, so the baguettes sit on the outside. About 12mm across.

STYLING TIP: Let them be the only earrings you wear; they do the work of a statement earring at stud size.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 12mm by 12mm
  • Pear: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10mm by 6.5mm
  • Baguette: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 9mm by 4.5mm
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Pair: Mirror images, the baguettes on the outside
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

k05.title: Heart Solitaire Drop Studs
k05.descriptionHtml:
A gold heart, and a stone that swings below it. Each earring is a small puffed heart in polished gold tone, about 7.5mm across, worn as a stud, with one round clear cubic zirconia of about 6mm hanging from a tiny jump ring at its point. About 17.5mm long, the stone moves as you do.

STYLING TIP: Wear them on their own every day, or with the Heart Solitaire Huggies in a second piercing.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17.5mm
  • Heart: Puffed and polished, approximately 7.5mm across
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm, in four fine gold claws
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

k06.title: Petite Pear Solitaire Ring
k06.descriptionHtml:
One pear, pointing to the fingertip. A single pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 9mm by 6mm, is held in fine gold claws and laid along the finger on a slim polished band about 1.5mm wide. The band is open at the back, so it adjusts to fit US 5 to 9.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Petite Pear Solitaire Studs, or with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 9
  • Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 9mm by 6mm
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Band: Plain polished, approximately 1.5mm, open at the back
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
